title: brief composition

setup.note: One set time over a world that has moved. Code composes the ledger from tasks/priority.ts, the derived calendar and what changed in the window; brief.v2 only phrases it. The call is a canned-JSON provider stub that can do nothing but read the packed ledger back — so an invented figure in the output would be a bug in the packer or the check, never the model.
standing: question 'Ma's ticket: AC or sleeper?' — open
task tsk_cab 'Book the cab' — due today
moved_in_window: space 'Goa trip in December' — latest: Rohan's twin confirmed Saturday
task tsk_visa 'Send the visa photos' — closed done

input_events: A brief window that holds a space update, a closed task and a finished artifact.
A standing approval, an open question, today's dinner and today's cab task.

expected.note: Needs-you, today and what moved. Code composes the ledger; one model call writes the prose.

wrong.label: extra-call
wrong.assert_absent: more than one model call for one brief

wrong.label: missing-part
wrong.assert_absent: a ledger that drops needs-you, today or what moved

wrong.label: empty-part
wrong.assert_absent: a part that comes back empty while the world model holds its rows

wrong.label: uncited-item
wrong.assert_absent: a ledger line with no source chip behind it

wrong.label: invented-figure
wrong.assert_absent: an amount, time or count in the prose that the ledger never held

wrong.label: missing-heading
wrong.assert_absent: prose that does not name all three parts
